text:
olivia: Quick finalization thread for next-week announce (Mon). Need final changelog link, docs preview with runnable snippets, exact canary ramp schedule, and HubSpot tag + routing rules by COB today. Embargo 11:00 UTC on Monday. Can eng confirm? @diego
diego: Yup. Proposed ramp: 2% for 10m -> 10% for 20m -> 50% for 30m -> 100%. Abort if 5xx > 0.6% OR p95 latency > 320ms. Will post the rollout gist in ~40m.
rina: Docs preview is up: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/142. Includes a tiny quickstart and an embeddings snippet. I'll swap the model name once diego confirms. Also added a short migration note for users on rwd-serve-v1.
olivia: Marketing will pull that preview into the blog draft and webinar deck. Need the changelog commit/hash to link release notes in the announce.
diego: Draft changelog commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/ghi789. Blurb: "Adaptive prefix caching and improved batching to reduce tail latency and cost for long-context workloads." Suggest we keep that exact sentence for the blog.
kevin: For inbound, use hubspot tag `launch_may23`. Routing: tag -> marketing/sdr. If usage > 75 reqs/day -> webhook to sales/tier1. I'll post the rule IDs after this.
olivia: Social plan: blog at T+0, thread at +10, short clip + webinar CTA at +60. Webinar landing: https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-better. Put the reg link in the blog CTA.
rina: I'll add the CTA and a small live curl example. Need final model string.
diego: Confirm model: `rwd-serve-v2` (no trailing flags). APAC will get staged after full rollout to avoid cold caches.
olivia: Can we schedule a 20m dry-run on Monday T-30m pre-publish for go/no-go and a quick parade of assets?
diego: I can do 09:20 UTC if announce is 09:50 UTC. I'll run through health checks and keep the rollback ready. Checklist: canary traffic, p50/p95 latency, error rates, top error traces, tail token time.
rina: I'll demo the quickstart and the migration note during dry-run.
kevin: Confirmed HubSpot flow. Rule IDs: marketing/queue/1829, sale-tier1-webhook/4472. I'll drop them in the ops doc.
olivia: One more ask: marketing needs a 1-line quote from eng explaining impact for the blog. Diego?
diego: "This release reduces tail latency for long-context inference by combining smarter batching with adaptive prefix caching, improving responsiveness and lowering cost for production workloads." Use it.
notify-bot: [deploy-schedule] canary requested by diego for 2026-05-23T09:20:00Z
olivia: Great — I'll finalize the blog draft and schedule T-30m reminder in #marketing. :rocket:
